I'll implement a basic pipeline that: (1) loads Llama-3-8B-Instruct locally, (2)
loads AdvBench (harmful prompts) and Alpaca (benign prompts), (3) formats
prompts with the chat template and extracts residual stream activations at the
final instruction-token position from a middle layer, (4) computes the
"harmfulness direction" as the difference of class means on a train split, (5)
trains a linear logistic regression probe on the 1D projection along that
direction and evaluates on a held-out set, and (6) saves metrics and a
projection histogram. I'll keep sample sizes modest (~200 per class) so it runs
quickly on a single GPU.

I'll implement a baseline for extracting a linear harmfulness direction from
Llama-3-8B-Instruct residual stream activations. The approach: (1) load AdvBench
(harmful) and Alpaca (benign) prompts, sample ~200 each; (2) run each through
Llama-3-8B with hooks capturing residual stream activations at the final
instruction-token position across several layers; (3) compute the difference-of-
means direction on a training split for each layer; (4) project held-out
activations onto this 1D direction and train a logistic regression probe; (5)
also compare against a random-direction baseline and report accuracy per layer.
I'll use bfloat16 on GPU, batch size 1 for simplicity, and apply the Llama-3
chat template so the final instruction-token position is well-defined. Results
and per-layer metrics are saved as numpy arrays and a plot.

I'll implement a minimal but complete pipeline: (1) load Llama-3-8B-Instruct
with local files, (2) load AdvBench harmful prompts and Alpaca benign prompts
robustly, (3) extract residual stream activations at the final instruction-token
position across selected layers, (4) compute difference-of-means direction on
train split, (5) train a 1D logistic-regression probe on projections, and (6)
report held-out probe accuracy with a random-direction baseline. I'll use chat
template formatting to get the correct final instruction token position, run in
fp16 on GPU with batch size 1 for stability, and cache activations. I'll do a
per-layer sweep (layers 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28) and pick best. Small sample sizes
(150 harmful + 150 benign) keep it under time budget.

The bug is that the fast tokenizer for Llama-3 requires `tiktoken` which is not
installed, and the slow tokenizer conversion needs `sentencepiece`. The fix is
to try loading with `use_fast=False` first, and if that fails, install/import
`tiktoken` fallback, or use `AutoTokenizer` with a try/except that attempts
alternative configurations. The simplest robust fix is to attempt fast
tokenizer, and if it fails, try installing tiktoken via pip at runtime or fall
back to loading with trust_remote_code and different settings.

The bug is that the tokenizer for Llama-3-8B-Instruct requires `tiktoken` and
`blobfile`, but the installation attempts happen before the import fails —
however the installs may not persist to the current process's import cache, or
the packages may not be actually installed. I'll fix by ensuring `tiktoken` and
`blobfile` are installed and importable before tokenizer loading, and also add
`protobuf` and `sentencepiece` as extra safety. If pip install succeeds, we
invalidate caches and re-import. Additionally, I'll try loading with
`use_fast=True` which is the correct path for tiktoken-based Llama-3 tokenizers.

I'll implement a straightforward pipeline that (1) does pre-flight validation of
packages/paths, (2) robustly loads AdvBench and Alpaca from `$DATA_DIR`, (3)
loads Llama-3-8B-Instruct with its fast tokenizer, (4) extracts residual-stream
activations at the final instruction-token position across several layers using
hidden_states, (5) computes a difference-of-means "harmfulness direction" on a
train split, (6) trains a 1D logistic-regression probe on projections along that
direction and evaluates held-out accuracy per layer, and (7) compares against a
random-direction baseline and saves projections/plots. I keep sample sizes
modest (150/class) for speed, use fp16 on GPU, and save all metrics to
`working_dir`.

I'll implement a minimal working pipeline: robust environment/dataset discovery,
load Llama-3-8B-Instruct with local files, format prompts with the chat
template, extract residual-stream activations at the final instruction-token
position from a few layers, compute a difference-of-means harmfulness direction,
and train a 1D logistic regression probe (with random-direction baseline). I'll
keep sample counts modest (~150/class) and sweep layers 8/12/16/20/24/28. I'll
verify the hooked token by decoding it. All results and per-layer metrics will
be saved with np.save.

The tokenizer failure is because the fast tokenizer needs `tokenizers` backend
properly, and protobuf install failed (pip name is `protobuf` but sometimes
needs specific handling). The real fix: install `protobuf` correctly (the
ensure_pkg tries to import `protobuf` which actually IS the module name, but the
install may need `--upgrade`). More robust fix: install `tokenizers` and
`protobuf` explicitly with proper handling, and also try loading tokenizer with
`legacy=False` for Llama-3 which uses tiktoken-based tokenizer. Also, for
Llama-3, the tokenizer.json should work with fast tokenizer if `tokenizers`
package is up to date - so upgrade it.

I'll implement a minimal but working pipeline to extract harmfulness directions
from Llama-3-8B-Instruct residual stream activations. The approach: (1) load
AdvBench (harmful) and Alpaca (benign) prompts with robust discovery; (2) format
each prompt with the Llama-3 chat template; (3) run a single forward pass per
prompt with hooks capturing residual-stream activations at the final
instruction-token position across a sweep of layers (8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28); (4)
compute a difference-of-means direction on the training split at each layer; (5)
train a 1D logistic-regression probe on the projection onto that direction and
evaluate held-out accuracy, alongside a random-direction baseline; (6) save all
metrics and a per-layer accuracy plot. I'll do robust pre-flight validation
(list model/data dirs, verify tokenizer loads, do one mini forward pass and
decode the hooked token) before running at scale, and use bf16 + batch-size-1
for memory stability.

The bug is that the AdvBench discovery uses `rglob_limited` which walks all of
`/data/zhenqian/data` (huge tree) and applies filename filters that don't match
— AdvBench likely lives directly under `/data/zhenqian/data/AdvBench` with a
standard CSV like `harmful_behaviors.csv`. I'll fix by directly targeting the
`AdvBench` and `Alpaca` subdirectories, listing their files, and loading the
first suitable CSV/JSON/parquet/arrow. I'll also add broader column name
matching (e.g., `goal`, `Goal`, `behavior`, `prompt`) and dataset-format
handling via `load_from_disk`.

The bug is that the fast tokenizer for Llama-3 requires either a
`tokenizer.json` file or `tiktoken`/`sentencepiece` to convert. The fix is to
try loading the fast tokenizer, and if it fails, fall back to installing/using
an alternative approach — specifically, we'll try `use_fast=False` with
sentencepiece, or install `tiktoken` on the fly. Simplest robust fix: try fast
first, catch the error, and try `use_fast=False`; if still failing, attempt to
install `tiktoken` via pip at runtime.

The bug is that Alpaca dataset loading failed. I'll fix this by broadening the
search to include more file formats (parquet, jsonl, arrow, HuggingFace dataset
directories), searching more thoroughly across `$DATA_DIR`, and adding support
for the common HuggingFace `datasets` library format. If still not found, I'll

intact.

The bug is that the tokenizer's `tokenizer.json` cannot be loaded because it
requires either `tiktoken` or `sentencepiece`, but even after attempting to
install them, the pip install likely didn't take effect in the current Python
process (or the `--quiet` install failed silently due to network issues). The
fix is to install `tiktoken` and `blobfile` upfront before importing
transformers, verify installation succeeded, and also check if the tokenizer
files are actually in a subdirectory (`Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct/Meta-
Llama-3-8B-Instruct/` based on the ls output showing nested naming). We'll also
try `AutoTokenizer` with `trust_remote_code=True` and explicit `tokenizer_file`

import os

working_dir = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "working")
os.makedirs(working_dir, exist_ok=True)

import json, glob, random, numpy as np, torch, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

DATA_DIR = "/data/zhenqian/data"
MODEL_DIR = "/data/zhenqian/models"

random.seed(0)
np.random.seed(0)
torch.manual_seed(0)

experiment_data = {
    "advbench_vs_alpaca": {
        "metrics": {"train": [], "val": []},
        "losses": {"train": [], "val": []},
        "predictions": [],
        "ground_truth": [],
        "harmful_projections": [],
        "benign_projections": [],
        "layer_used": None,
        "direction_norm": None,
    }
}


# ---------- Load datasets ----------
def find_file(root, names):
    for n in names:
        p = os.path.join(root, n)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return p
    # search
    for ext in ["csv", "json", "jsonl", "parquet"]:
        hits = glob.glob(os.path.join(root, f"**/*.{ext}"), recursive=True)
        if hits:
            return hits[0]
    return None


def load_advbench():
    root = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "advbench")
    if not os.path.isdir(root):
        # try alternate
        for cand in ["AdvBench", "advbench_behaviors"]:
            r = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, cand)
            if os.path.isdir(r):
                root = r
                break
    fp = find_file(root, ["harmful_behaviors.csv", "behaviors.csv", "advbench.csv"])
    print("AdvBench file:", fp)
    if fp.endswith(".csv"):
        df = pd.read_csv(fp)
    elif fp.endswith(".parquet"):
        df = pd.read_parquet(fp)
    else:
        df = pd.read_json(fp, lines=fp.endswith(".jsonl"))
    col = (
        "goal"
        if "goal" in df.columns
        else ("behavior" if "behavior" in df.columns else df.columns[0])
    )
    return df[col].astype(str).tolist()


def load_alpaca():
    root = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "alpaca")
    if not os.path.isdir(root):
        for cand in ["Alpaca", "alpaca_data", "stanford_alpaca"]:
            r = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, cand)
            if os.path.isdir(r):
                root = r
                break
    fp = find_file(root, ["alpaca_data.json", "alpaca.json", "train.json", "data.json"])
    print("Alpaca file:", fp)
    if fp.endswith(".json"):
        try:
            data = json.load(open(fp))
        except Exception:
            data = [json.loads(l) for l in open(fp)]
    elif fp.endswith(".jsonl"):
        data = [json.loads(l) for l in open(fp)]
    elif fp.endswith(".parquet"):
        data = pd.read_parquet(fp).to_dict("records")
    else:
        data = pd.read_csv(fp).to_dict("records")
    prompts = []
    for ex in data:
        instr = ex.get("instruction", "")
        inp = ex.get("input", "")
        if inp and str(inp).strip():
            prompts.append(f"{instr}\n{inp}")
        else:
            prompts.append(instr)
    return [p for p in prompts if isinstance(p, str) and len(p.strip()) > 0]


harmful = load_advbench()
benign = load_alpaca()
print(f"Harmful: {len(harmful)}, Benign: {len(benign)}")

N_PER_CLASS = 250
random.shuffle(harmful)
random.shuffle(benign)
harmful = harmful[:N_PER_CLASS]
benign = benign[:N_PER_CLASS]

# ---------- Load model ----------
model_path = os.path.join(MODEL_DIR, "Llama-3-8B-Instruct")
if not os.path.isdir(model_path):
    for cand in [
        "Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct",
        "llama-3-8b-instruct",
        "Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct",
    ]:
        p = os.path.join(MODEL_DIR, cand)
        if os.path.isdir(p):
            model_path = p
            break
print("Model path:", model_path)

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path, local_files_only=True)
if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
    tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
    model_path,
    local_files_only=True,
    torch_dtype=torch.float16,
    device_map={"": device},
    output_hidden_states=False,
)
model.eval()

n_layers = model.config.num_hidden_layers
LAYER = n_layers // 2  # middle layer
experiment_data["advbench_vs_alpaca"]["layer_used"] = LAYER
print(f"Using layer {LAYER} of {n_layers}")

# hook on that layer's output
_cache = {}


def hook(mod, inp, out):
    h = out[0] if isinstance(out, tuple) else out
    _cache["h"] = h.detach()


target_layer = model.model.layers[LAYER]
handle = target_layer.register_forward_hook(hook)


def format_prompt(text):
    msgs = [{"role": "user", "content": text}]
    return tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
        msgs, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=False
    )


def get_activation(text):
    prompt = format_prompt(text)
    enc = tokenizer(prompt, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=512).to(
        device
    )
    with torch.no_grad():
        model(**enc)
    h = _cache["h"]  # [1, T, D]
    # last non-pad token = final instruction token position
    last_idx = enc["attention_mask"].sum(dim=1).item() - 1
    return h[0, last_idx].float().cpu().numpy()


def batch_activations(texts):
    acts = []
    for i, t in enumerate(texts):
        try:
            acts.append(get_activation(t))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"skip {i}: {e}")
        if (i + 1) % 50 == 0:
            print(f"  processed {i+1}/{len(texts)}")
    return np.stack(acts)


print("Extracting harmful activations...")
X_h = batch_activations(harmful)
print("Extracting benign activations...")
X_b = batch_activations(benign)
handle.remove()

X = np.concatenate([X_h, X_b], axis=0)
y = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(X_h)), np.zeros(len(X_b))]).astype(int)

# train/val split
idx = np.arange(len(X))
np.random.shuffle(idx)
split = int(0.8 * len(idx))
tr, va = idx[:split], idx[split:]
Xtr, ytr = X[tr], y[tr]
Xva, yva = X[va], y[va]

# ---------- Extract harmfulness direction via difference of means (train only) ----------
mu_h = Xtr[ytr == 1].mean(0)
mu_b = Xtr[ytr == 0].mean(0)
direction = mu_h - mu_b
direction = direction / (np.linalg.norm(direction) + 1e-8)
experiment_data["advbench_vs_alpaca"]["direction_norm"] = float(
    np.linalg.norm(mu_h - mu_b)
)

proj_tr = Xtr @ direction
proj_va = Xva @ direction

# ---------- Linear probe on 1D projection ----------
clf = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
clf.fit(proj_tr.reshape(-1, 1), ytr)
train_pred = clf.predict(proj_tr.reshape(-1, 1))
val_pred = clf.predict(proj_va.reshape(-1, 1))
train_acc = accuracy_score(ytr, train_pred)
val_acc = accuracy_score(yva, val_pred)

# also full-dim probe for comparison
clf_full = LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000)
clf_full.fit(Xtr, ytr)
val_acc_full = accuracy_score(yva, clf_full.predict(Xva))

print(f"Epoch 0: validation_loss = {(1-val_acc):.4f}")
print(f"harmfulness_direction_probe_accuracy (1D projection, val): {val_acc:.4f}")
print(f"train accuracy (1D projection): {train_acc:.4f}")
print(f"full-dim linear probe val accuracy (reference): {val_acc_full:.4f}")

experiment_data["advbench_vs_alpaca"]["metrics"]["train"].append(
    {"epoch": 0, "acc": float(train_acc)}
)
experiment_data["advbench_vs_alpaca"]["metrics"]["val"].append(
    {"epoch": 0, "acc": float(val_acc), "acc_full": float(val_acc_full)}
)
experiment_data["advbench_vs_alpaca"]["losses"]["train"].append(
    {"epoch": 0, "loss": float(1 - train_acc)}
)
experiment_data["advbench_vs_alpaca"]["losses"]["val"].append(
    {"epoch": 0, "loss": float(1 - val_acc)}
)
experiment_data["advbench_vs_alpaca"]["predictions"] = val_pred.tolist()
experiment_data["advbench_vs_alpaca"]["ground_truth"] = yva.tolist()
experiment_data["advbench_vs_alpaca"]["harmful_projections"] = proj_va[
    yva == 1
].tolist()
experiment_data["advbench_vs_alpaca"]["benign_projections"] = proj_va[yva == 0].tolist()

# ---------- Visualization ----------
plt.figure(figsize=(7, 4))
plt.hist(proj_va[yva == 1], bins=30, alpha=0.6, label="harmful (AdvBench)")
plt.hist(proj_va[yva == 0], bins=30, alpha=0.6, label="benign (Alpaca)")
plt.xlabel("projection on harmfulness direction")
plt.ylabel("count")
plt.title(f"Layer {LAYER} projections (val acc={val_acc:.3f})")
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(os.path.join(working_dir, "harmfulness_projection_hist.png"), dpi=120)
plt.close()

np.save(os.path.join(working_dir, "experiment_data.npy"), experiment_data)
print("Saved to", working_dir)
import os

working_dir = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "working")
os.makedirs(working_dir, exist_ok=True)

import json
import numpy as np
import torch
import pandas as pd
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import random

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

DATA_DIR = "/data/zhenqian/data"
MODEL_DIR = "/data/zhenqian/models"

MODEL_PATH = os.path.join(MODEL_DIR, "Llama-3-8B-Instruct")
if not os.path.isdir(MODEL_PATH):
    # try alternative naming
    for cand in [
        "Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct",
        "llama-3-8b-instruct",
        "Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct",
    ]:
        p = os.path.join(MODEL_DIR, cand)
        if os.path.isdir(p):
            MODEL_PATH = p
            break
print(f"Model path: {MODEL_PATH}")


# ---------- Load data ----------
def load_advbench():
    # AdvBench: try common file names
    candidates = [
        os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "advbench", "harmful_behaviors.csv"),
        os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "AdvBench", "harmful_behaviors.csv"),
        os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "advbench", "data", "harmful_behaviors.csv"),
    ]
    for c in candidates:
        if os.path.isfile(c):
            df = pd.read_csv(c)
            col = "goal" if "goal" in df.columns else df.columns[0]
            return df[col].astype(str).tolist()
    # search
    for root, _, files in os.walk(os.path.join(DATA_DIR)):
        for f in files:
            if f == "harmful_behaviors.csv":
                df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(root, f))
                col = "goal" if "goal" in df.columns else df.columns[0]
                return df[col].astype(str).tolist()
    raise FileNotFoundError("AdvBench harmful_behaviors.csv not found")


def load_alpaca():
    candidates = [
        os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "alpaca", "alpaca_data.json"),
        os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "Alpaca", "alpaca_data.json"),
        os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "alpaca_data.json"),
    ]
    for c in candidates:
        if os.path.isfile(c):
            with open(c, "r") as f:
                data = json.load(f)
            prompts = []
            for d in data:
                inst = d.get("instruction", "").strip()
                inp = d.get("input", "").strip()
                if inp:
                    inst = inst + "\n" + inp
                if inst:
                    prompts.append(inst)
            return prompts
    # try parquet
    for root, _, files in os.walk(os.path.join(DATA_DIR)):
        if "alpaca" in root.lower():
            for f in files:
                if f.endswith(".json"):
                    with open(os.path.join(root, f), "r") as fp:
                        try:
                            data = json.load(fp)
                        except Exception:
                            continue
                    if (
                        isinstance(data, list)
                        and len(data) > 0
                        and "instruction" in data[0]
                    ):
                        prompts = []
                        for d in data:
                            inst = d.get("instruction", "").strip()
                            inp = d.get("input", "").strip()
                            if inp:
                                inst = inst + "\n" + inp
                            if inst:
                                prompts.append(inst)
                        return prompts
                if f.endswith(".parquet"):
                    try:
                        df = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(root, f))
                        if "instruction" in df.columns:
                            prompts = []
                            for _, row in df.iterrows():
                                inst = str(row.get("instruction", "")).strip()
                                inp = (
                                    str(row.get("input", "")).strip()
                                    if "input" in df.columns
                                    else ""
                                )
                                if inp and inp != "nan":
                                    inst = inst + "\n" + inp
                                if inst:
                                    prompts.append(inst)
                            return prompts
                    except Exception:
                        pass
    raise FileNotFoundError("Alpaca dataset not found")


harmful = load_advbench()
benign = load_alpaca()
print(f"Loaded AdvBench: {len(harmful)}, Alpaca: {len(benign)}")

random.seed(0)
N = 200
harmful = random.sample(harmful, min(N, len(harmful)))
# Filter benign by rough length similarity to harmful prompts
h_lens = [len(x) for x in harmful]
med_len = int(np.median(h_lens))
benign_filtered = [b for b in benign if 20 <= len(b) <= max(300, med_len * 3)]
benign = random.sample(benign_filtered, min(N, len(benign_filtered)))
print(f"Sampled harmful: {len(harmful)}, benign: {len(benign)}")

# ---------- Load model ----------
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_PATH, local_files_only=True)
if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
    tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
    MODEL_PATH,
    torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
    local_files_only=True,
    device_map=None,
).to(device)
model.eval()

num_layers = model.config.num_hidden_layers
hidden_size = model.config.hidden_size
print(f"num_layers={num_layers}, hidden_size={hidden_size}")

# Choose layers to probe (sweep)
probe_layers = sorted(set([4, 8, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 28, num_layers - 1]))
probe_layers = [l for l in probe_layers if 0 <= l < num_layers]
print(f"Probing layers: {probe_layers}")


# ---------- Extract activations ----------
def format_prompt(text):
    # Use Llama-3 chat template up to end of user turn (final instruction token position)
    try:
        s = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            [{"role": "user", "content": text}],
            tokenize=False,
            add_generation_prompt=False,
        )
    except Exception:
        s = f"<|begin_of_text|><|start_header_id|>user<|end_header_id|>\n\n{text}<|eot_id|>"
    return s


def get_activations(prompts, max_len=256):
    # returns dict layer -> np.array [N, hidden_size]
    acts = {l: [] for l in probe_layers}
    with torch.no_grad():
        for i, p in enumerate(prompts):
            s = format_prompt(p)
            enc = tokenizer(s, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=max_len)
            enc = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in enc.items()}
            out = model(**enc, output_hidden_states=True, use_cache=False)
            hs = out.hidden_states  # tuple of (num_layers+1) tensors [1, seq, hidden]
            last_pos = enc["input_ids"].shape[1] - 1
            for l in probe_layers:
                # hidden_states[0] is embeddings, so layer l residual is hs[l+1]... but we want post-layer-l output.
                # Use hs[l+1] as output of layer l.
                vec = hs[l + 1][0, last_pos, :].float().cpu().numpy()
                acts[l].append(vec)
            if (i + 1) % 20 == 0:
                print(f"  extracted {i+1}/{len(prompts)}")
    return {l: np.stack(v) for l, v in acts.items()}


print("Extracting harmful activations...")
h_acts = get_activations(harmful)
print("Extracting benign activations...")
b_acts = get_activations(benign)

# ---------- Train probes ----------
experiment_data = {
    "advbench_alpaca": {
        "metrics": {"train": [], "val": []},
        "losses": {"train": [], "val": []},
        "predictions": [],
        "ground_truth": [],
        "layers": probe_layers,
        "per_layer_probe_acc": {},
        "per_layer_random_acc": {},
        "per_layer_direction_norm": {},
    }
}

        except Exception as e:

LAYERS = [8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28]

def format_prompt(text):
    messages = [{"role": "user", "content": text}]
    # Apply chat template WITHOUT generation prompt so last token is end of instruction
    formatted = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
        messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=False
    )
    return formatted


@torch.no_grad()
def extract_activations(prompts, label):
    # returns dict layer -> np.array [N, hidden]
    out = {L: [] for L in LAYERS}
    for i, p in enumerate(prompts):
        text = format_prompt(p)
        inputs = tokenizer(
            text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=MAX_LEN
        ).to(device)
        outputs = model(**inputs, output_hidden_states=True, use_cache=False)
        hs = outputs.hidden_states  # tuple of (num_layers+1) tensors [1, seq, hidden]
        last_idx = inputs["input_ids"].shape[1] - 1
        for L in LAYERS:
            vec = hs[L][0, last_idx].float().cpu().numpy()
            out[L].append(vec)
        if (i + 1) % 25 == 0:
            print(f"  {label}: {i+1}/{len(prompts)}")
    return {L: np.stack(out[L]) for L in LAYERS}

def split_train_val(X_h, X_b, seed=0):
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n_h = len(X_h)
    n_b = len(X_b)
    idx_h = rng.permutation(n_h)
    idx_b = rng.permutation(n_b)
    n_train_h = int(0.7 * n_h)
    n_train_b = int(0.7 * n_b)
    Xh_tr = X_h[idx_h[:n_train_h]]
    Xh_val = X_h[idx_h[n_train_h:]]
    Xb_tr = X_b[idx_b[:n_train_b]]
    Xb_val = X_b[idx_b[n_train_b:]]
    X_tr = np.concatenate([Xh_tr, Xb_tr])
    y_tr = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(Xh_tr)), np.zeros(len(Xb_tr))])
    X_val = np.concatenate([Xh_val, Xb_val])
    y_val = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(Xh_val)), np.zeros(len(Xb_val))])
    return X_tr, y_tr, X_val, y_val


results = {}
best_layer = None
best_acc = -1
for L in LAYERS:
    X_h = harmful_acts[L]
    X_b = benign_acts[L]
    X_tr, y_tr, X_val, y_val = split_train_val(X_h, X_b)

    # Difference of means direction from TRAIN only
    mu_h = X_tr[y_tr == 1].mean(0)
    mu_b = X_tr[y_tr == 0].mean(0)
    direction = mu_h - mu_b
    direction = direction / (np.linalg.norm(direction) + 1e-8)

    # 1D projections
    proj_tr = X_tr @ direction
    proj_val = X_val @ direction

    clf = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
    clf.fit(proj_tr.reshape(-1, 1), y_tr)
    train_pred = clf.predict(proj_tr.reshape(-1, 1))
    val_pred = clf.predict(proj_val.reshape(-1, 1))
    train_acc = accuracy_score(y_tr, train_pred)
    val_acc = accuracy_score(y_val, val_pred)
    val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, proj_val)

    # Random direction baseline
    rng = np.random.RandomState(42)
    rand_dir = rng.randn(direction.shape[0])
    rand_dir /= np.linalg.norm(rand_dir)
    rp_tr = X_tr @ rand_dir
    rp_val = X_val @ rand_dir
    rclf = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
    rclf.fit(rp_tr.reshape(-1, 1), y_tr)
    rand_val_acc = accuracy_score(y_val, rclf.predict(rp_val.reshape(-1, 1)))

    # Compute cross-entropy losses
    def bce(clf_, X_, y_):
        p = clf_.predict_proba(X_)[:, 1]
        p = np.clip(p, 1e-7, 1 - 1e-7)
        return float(-np.mean(y_ * np.log(p) + (1 - y_) * np.log(1 - p)))

    train_loss = bce(clf, proj_tr.reshape(-1, 1), y_tr)
    val_loss = bce(clf, proj_val.reshape(-1, 1), y_val)

    print(
        f"Layer {L}: train_acc={train_acc:.4f} val_acc={val_acc:.4f} val_auc={val_auc:.4f} rand_val_acc={rand_val_acc:.4f} val_loss={val_loss:.4f}"
    )
    print(f"Epoch {L}: validation_loss = {val_loss:.4f}")

    results[L] = {
        "train_acc": train_acc,
        "val_acc": val_acc,
        "val_auc": val_auc,
        "random_val_acc": rand_val_acc,
        "train_loss": train_loss,
        "val_loss": val_loss,
        "direction": direction,
    }
    experiment_data["advbench_vs_alpaca"]["metrics"]["train"].append((L, train_acc))
    experiment_data["advbench_vs_alpaca"]["metrics"]["val"].append((L, val_acc))

    experiment_data["advbench_vs_alpaca"]["losses"]["val"].append((L, val_loss))
    experiment_data["advbench_vs_alpaca"]["per_layer"][L] = {
        "train_acc": train_acc,
        "val_acc": val_acc,
        "val_auc": val_auc,
        "random_val_acc": rand_val_acc,
        "direction": direction,
    }

    if val_acc > best_acc:
        best_acc = val_acc
        best_layer = L

def find_file(root, names):
    for n in names:
        p = os.path.join(root, n)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return p
    for ext in ["csv", "json", "jsonl", "parquet"]:
        hits = glob.glob(os.path.join(root, f"**/*.{ext}"), recursive=True)
        if hits:
            return hits[0]
    return None

            if os.path.isdir(r):
                root = r
                break
    fp = find_file(root, ["harmful_behaviors.csv", "behaviors.csv", "advbench.csv"])
    print("AdvBench file:", fp)
    if fp.endswith(".csv"):
        df = pd.read_csv(fp)
    elif fp.endswith(".parquet"):
        df = pd.read_parquet(fp)
    else:
        df = pd.read_json(fp, lines=fp.endswith(".jsonl"))
    col = (
        "goal"
        if "goal" in df.columns

    )
    return df[col].astype(str).tolist()

def ensure_pkg(pkg, import_name=None):
    import_name = import_name or pkg
    try:
        importlib.import_module(import_name)
        return True
    except ImportError:
        try:
            subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "-q", pkg])
            importlib.invalidate_caches()
            importlib.import_module(import_name)
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Failed to install {pkg}: {e}")
            return False

def find_file(root, names):
    for n in names:
        p = os.path.join(root, n)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return p
    for ext in ["csv", "json", "jsonl", "parquet"]:
        hits = glob.glob(os.path.join(root, f"**/*.{ext}"), recursive=True)
        if hits:
            return hits[0]
    return None

    if fp.endswith(".csv"):
        df = pd.read_csv(fp)
    elif fp.endswith(".parquet"):
        df = pd.read_parquet(fp)
    else:
        df = pd.read_json(fp, lines=fp.endswith(".jsonl"))
    col = (
        "goal"
        if "goal" in df.columns

    )

    print("Alpaca file:", fp)
    if fp.endswith(".json"):
        try:
            data = json.load(open(fp))
        except Exception:
            data = [json.loads(l) for l in open(fp)]
    elif fp.endswith(".jsonl"):
        data = [json.loads(l) for l in open(fp)]
    elif fp.endswith(".parquet"):
        data = pd.read_parquet(fp).to_dict("records")
    else:
        data = pd.read_csv(fp).to_dict("records")
    prompts = []
    for ex in data:
        instr = ex.get("instruction", "")
        inp = ex.get("input", "")
        if inp and str(inp).strip():
            prompts.append(f"{instr}\n{inp}")
        else:
            prompts.append(instr)
    return [p for p in prompts if isinstance(p, str) and len(p.strip()) > 0]

            device
        )
        out = model(**enc, output_hidden_states=True, use_cache=False)
        hs = out.hidden_states  # tuple of (n_layers+1,) each [1, T, H]
        last_idx = enc["input_ids"].shape[1] - 1
        for L in LAYERS:
            v = hs[L][0, last_idx, :].float().cpu().numpy()
            acts[L].append(v)
        if (i + 1) % 25 == 0:
            print(f"  extracted {i+1}/{len(prompts)}")
            torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    return {L: np.stack(v) for L, v in acts.items()}

def rglob_limited(root, max_files=20000):
    out = []
    for dp, dn, fn in os.walk(root):
        for f in fn:
            out.append(os.path.join(dp, f))
            if len(out) >= max_files:
                return out
    return out

def format_prompt(text):
    messages = [{"role": "user", "content": text}]
    return tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
        messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=False
    )


# find final instruction-token index: use the position just before assistant header if present,
# otherwise use last token. We'll use the last non-pad token of the formatted user turn (no gen prompt).
LAYERS_TO_PROBE = [8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28]


@torch.no_grad()
def get_activations(prompts):
    acts = {L: [] for L in LAYERS_TO_PROBE}
    verified = False
    for i, p in enumerate(prompts):
        text = format_prompt(p)
        enc = tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=512).to(
            device
        )
        out = model(**enc, output_hidden_states=True, use_cache=False)
        # hidden_states: tuple of (n_layers+1) [B, T, D]
        last_idx = enc["attention_mask"].sum(dim=1).item() - 1
        if not verified:
            tok_id = enc["input_ids"][0, last_idx].item()
            print(f"  final instr token decoded: {repr(tokenizer.decode([tok_id]))}")
            verified = True
        for L in LAYERS_TO_PROBE:
            h = out.hidden_states[L][0, last_idx, :].float().cpu().numpy()
            acts[L].append(h)
        if (i + 1) % 50 == 0:
            print(f"  extracted {i+1}/{len(prompts)}")
    return {L: np.stack(v) for L, v in acts.items()}

from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

results = {}
for L in LAYERS_TO_PROBE:
    X_h = harm_acts[L]  # (Nh, D)
    X_b = ben_acts[L]
    X = np.concatenate([X_h, X_b], axis=0)
    y = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(X_h)), np.zeros(len(X_b))]).astype(np.int64)
    X_tr, X_te, y_tr, y_te = train_test_split(
        X, y, test_size=0.3, random_state=42, stratify=y
    )

    # difference-of-means direction on TRAIN only
    mu_h = X_tr[y_tr == 1].mean(0)
    mu_b = X_tr[y_tr == 0].mean(0)
    dir_vec = mu_h - mu_b
    dir_vec = dir_vec / (np.linalg.norm(dir_vec) + 1e-8)

    # project onto 1D and probe
    p_tr = X_tr @ dir_vec
    p_te = X_te @ dir_vec
    clf = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
    clf.fit(p_tr.reshape(-1, 1), y_tr)
    train_acc = clf.score(p_tr.reshape(-1, 1), y_tr)
    val_acc = clf.score(p_te.reshape(-1, 1), y_te)

    # random direction baseline (avg over 5)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    rand_accs = []
    for _ in range(5):
        r = rng.standard_normal(dir_vec.shape[0])
        r /= np.linalg.norm(r) + 1e-8
        clf_r = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
        clf_r.fit((X_tr @ r).reshape(-1, 1), y_tr)
        rand_accs.append(clf_r.score((X_te @ r).reshape(-1, 1), y_te))
    rand_acc = float(np.mean(rand_accs))

    # shuffled-label control
    y_tr_shuf = y_tr.copy()
    rng.shuffle(y_tr_shuf)
    mu_h_s = X_tr[y_tr_shuf == 1].mean(0)
    mu_b_s = X_tr[y_tr_shuf == 0].mean(0)
    d_s = mu_h_s - mu_b_s
    d_s /= np.linalg.norm(d_s) + 1e-8
    clf_s = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
    clf_s.fit((X_tr @ d_s).reshape(-1, 1), y_tr_shuf)
    shuf_acc = clf_s.score((X_te @ d_s).reshape(-1, 1), y_te)

    # pseudo "loss" as 1 - acc (for tracking)
    val_loss = 1.0 - val_acc
    train_loss = 1.0 - train_acc
    print(
        f"Layer {L}: train_acc={train_acc:.4f} val_acc={val_acc:.4f} random_baseline={rand_acc:.4f} shuffled={shuf_acc:.4f}"
    )
    print(f"Epoch {L}: validation_loss = {val_loss:.4f}")

    experiment_data["llama3_advbench_alpaca"]["metrics"]["train"].append(
        {"layer": L, "acc": train_acc}
    )
    experiment_data["llama3_advbench_alpaca"]["metrics"]["val"].append(
        {"layer": L, "acc": val_acc, "random": rand_acc, "shuffled": shuf_acc}
    )
    experiment_data["llama3_advbench_alpaca"]["losses"]["train"].append(
        {"layer": L, "loss": train_loss}
    )
    experiment_data["llama3_advbench_alpaca"]["losses"]["val"].append(
        {"layer": L, "loss": val_loss}
    )
    experiment_data["llama3_advbench_alpaca"]["per_layer"][L] = {
        "train_acc": float(train_acc),
        "val_acc": float(val_acc),
        "random_acc": float(rand_acc),
        "shuffled_acc": float(shuf_acc),
        "direction_norm": float(np.linalg.norm(mu_h - mu_b)),
    }
    results[L] = (val_acc, rand_acc)

# best layer

def pip_install(args):
    try:
        subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "-q"] + args)
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"pip install failed for {args}: {e}")
        return False


def ensure_pkg(pkg, import_name=None, upgrade=False):
    import_name = import_name or pkg
    try:
        importlib.import_module(import_name)
        if not upgrade:
            return True
    except ImportError:
        pass
    args = ["--upgrade", pkg] if upgrade else [pkg]
    pip_install(args)
    importlib.invalidate_caches()
    try:
        importlib.import_module(import_name)
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Failed importing {import_name}: {e}")
        return False

def find_file(root, names):
    for n in names:
        p = os.path.join(root, n)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return p
    for ext in ["csv", "json", "jsonl", "parquet"]:
        hits = glob.glob(os.path.join(root, f"**/*.{ext}"), recursive=True)
        if hits:
            return hits[0]
    return None


def load_advbench():
    root = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "advbench")
    if not os.path.isdir(root):
        for cand in ["AdvBench", "advbench_behaviors"]:
            r = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, cand)
            if os.path.isdir(r):
                root = r
                break
    fp = find_file(root, ["harmful_behaviors.csv", "behaviors.csv", "advbench.csv"])
    print("AdvBench file:", fp)
    if fp.endswith(".csv"):
        df = pd.read_csv(fp)
    elif fp.endswith(".parquet"):
        df = pd.read_parquet(fp)
    else:
        df = pd.read_json(fp, lines=fp.endswith(".jsonl"))
    col = (
        "goal"
        if "goal" in df.columns
        else ("behavior" if "behavior" in df.columns else df.columns[0])
    )
    return df[col].astype(str).tolist()


def load_alpaca():
    root = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "alpaca")
    if not os.path.isdir(root):
        for cand in ["Alpaca", "alpaca_data", "stanford_alpaca"]:
            r = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, cand)
            if os.path.isdir(r):
                root = r
                break
    fp = find_file(root, ["alpaca_data.json", "alpaca.json", "train.json", "data.json"])
    print("Alpaca file:", fp)
    if fp.endswith(".json"):
        try:
            data = json.load(open(fp))
        except Exception:
            data = [json.loads(l) for l in open(fp)]
    elif fp.endswith(".jsonl"):
        data = [json.loads(l) for l in open(fp)]
    elif fp.endswith(".parquet"):
        data = pd.read_parquet(fp).to_dict("records")
    else:
        data = pd.read_csv(fp).to_dict("records")
    prompts = []
    for ex in data:
        instr = ex.get("instruction", "") if isinstance(ex, dict) else ""
        inp = ex.get("input", "") if isinstance(ex, dict) else ""
        if inp and str(inp).strip():
            prompts.append(f"{instr}\n{inp}")
        else:
            prompts.append(instr)
    return [p for p in prompts if isinstance(p, str) and len(p.strip()) > 0]

def find_advbench_prompts():
    # Try common locations
    candidates = []
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(DATA_DIR):
        if "advbench" in root.lower():
            for f in files:
                candidates.append(os.path.join(root, f))
        for f in files:
            if "advbench" in f.lower() or "harmful_behaviors" in f.lower():
                candidates.append(os.path.join(root, f))
    candidates = list(set(candidates))
    print(f"AdvBench candidate files ({len(candidates)}):", candidates[:20])
    prompts = []
    for path in candidates:
        try:
            if path.endswith(".csv"):
                import pandas as pd

                df = pd.read_csv(path)
                col = None
                for c in df.columns:
                    if (
                        "goal" in c.lower()
                        or "prompt" in c.lower()
                        or "behavior" in c.lower()
                    ):
                        col = c
                        break
                if col is None:
                    col = df.columns[0]
                prompts.extend(
                    [
                        str(x)
                        for x in df[col].tolist()
                        if isinstance(x, str) and len(x) > 3
                    ]
                )
            elif path.endswith(".json") or path.endswith(".jsonl"):
                with open(path, "r") as f:
                    if path.endswith(".jsonl"):
                        for line in f:
                            try:
                                d = json.loads(line)
                                for k in (
                                    "goal",
                                    "prompt",
                                    "behavior",
                                    "instruction",
                                    "query",
                                ):
                                    if k in d and isinstance(d[k], str):
                                        prompts.append(d[k])
                                        break
                            except:
                                pass
                    else:
                        data = json.load(f)
                        if isinstance(data, list):
                            for d in data:
                                if isinstance(d, dict):
                                    for k in (
                                        "goal",
                                        "prompt",
                                        "behavior",
                                        "instruction",
                                        "query",
                                    ):
                                        if k in d and isinstance(d[k], str):
                                            prompts.append(d[k])
                                            break
                                elif isinstance(d, str):
                                    prompts.append(d)
            elif path.endswith(".txt"):
                with open(path, "r") as f:
                    for line in f:
                        line = line.strip()
                        if line and len(line) > 5:
                            prompts.append(line)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  failed reading {path}: {e}")
    # dedup
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for p in prompts:
        if p not in seen:
            seen.add(p)
            out.append(p)
    return out


def find_alpaca_prompts():
    candidates = []
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(DATA_DIR):
        if "alpaca" in root.lower():
            for f in files:
                candidates.append(os.path.join(root, f))
    candidates = list(set(candidates))
    print(f"Alpaca candidate files ({len(candidates)}):", candidates[:20])
    prompts = []
    # Try HF dataset load_from_disk
    try:
        from datasets import load_from_disk, load_dataset

        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(DATA_DIR):
            if "alpaca" in root.lower() and (
                "dataset_info.json" in files or "state.json" in files
            ):
                try:
                    ds = load_from_disk(root)
                    if hasattr(ds, "keys"):
                        ds = ds[list(ds.keys())[0]]
                    for ex in ds:
                        if "instruction" in ex and isinstance(ex["instruction"], str):
                            prompts.append(ex["instruction"])
                    print(f"  loaded {len(prompts)} from {root}")
                    if prompts:
                        return prompts
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"  load_from_disk failed: {e}")
    except Exception as e:
        print("datasets import failed:", e)
    for path in candidates:
        try:
            if path.endswith(".json"):
                with open(path, "r") as f:
                    data = json.load(f)
                if isinstance(data, list):
                    for d in data:
                        if isinstance(d, dict) and "instruction" in d:
                            prompts.append(d["instruction"])
            elif path.endswith(".jsonl"):
                with open(path, "r") as f:
                    for line in f:
                        try:
                            d = json.loads(line)
                            if "instruction" in d:
                                prompts.append(d["instruction"])
                        except:
                            pass
            elif path.endswith(".parquet"):
                import pandas as pd

                df = pd.read_parquet(path)
                if "instruction" in df.columns:
                    prompts.extend(
                        [
                            str(x)
                            for x in df["instruction"].tolist()
                            if isinstance(x, str)
                        ]
                    )
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  failed reading {path}: {e}")
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for p in prompts:
        if p and p not in seen:
            seen.add(p)
            out.append(p)
    return out

captured = {}


def make_hook(layer_idx):
    def hook(module, inp, out):
        # out is a tuple for decoder layer; first element is hidden states
        h = out[0] if isinstance(out, tuple) else out
        # capture last token only (final instruction position)
        captured[layer_idx] = h[0, -1, :].detach().float().cpu()

    return hook

def get_activations(text, max_len=512):
    enc = tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=max_len)

    attn = enc.attention_mask.to(device)
    captured.clear()
    _ = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attn, use_cache=False)
    return {li: captured[li].clone() for li in LAYERS}

def collect(prompts, label):
    feats = {li: [] for li in LAYERS}
    for i, p in enumerate(prompts):
        try:
            text = format_prompt(p)
            acts = get_activations(text)
            for li in LAYERS:
                feats[li].append(acts[li].numpy())
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  [{label} {i}] failed: {e}")
            continue
        if (i + 1) % 25 == 0:
            print(f"  {label}: {i+1}/{len(prompts)}")
    for li in LAYERS:
        feats[li] = (
            np.stack(feats[li], axis=0)
            if feats[li]
            else np.zeros((0, model.config.hidden_size))
        )
    return feats

    proj_tr = Xtr @ direction
    proj_te = Xte @ direction

    clf = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
    clf.fit(proj_tr.reshape(-1, 1), ytr)

    pred_te = clf.predict(proj_te.reshape(-1, 1))
    prob_tr = clf.predict_proba(proj_tr.reshape(-1, 1))
    prob_te = clf.predict_proba(proj_te.reshape(-1, 1))

    train_acc = accuracy_score(ytr, pred_tr)
    val_acc = accuracy_score(yte, pred_te)
    train_loss = log_loss(ytr, prob_tr, labels=[0, 1])
    val_loss = log_loss(yte, prob_te, labels=[0, 1])

    rng = np.random.RandomState(0)
    rand_dir = rng.randn(direction.shape[0]).astype(np.float32)
    rand_dir /= np.linalg.norm(rand_dir) + 1e-8
    rp_tr = Xtr @ rand_dir
    rp_te = Xte @ rand_dir
    rclf = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
    rclf.fit(rp_tr.reshape(-1, 1), ytr)
    rand_acc = accuracy_score(yte, rclf.predict(rp_te.reshape(-1, 1)))

    experiment_data["harmfulness_direction"]["per_layer_random_acc"].append(rand_acc)

    per_layer_results[li] = {

        "val_pred": pred_te,

def list_files(root, max_files=5000):
    out = []
    if not os.path.isdir(root):

    for dp, dn, fn in os.walk(root):
        for f in fn:
            out.append(os.path.join(dp, f))
            if len(out) >= max_files:

def try_load_csv(p, cols):
    import pandas as pd

    try:
        df = pd.read_csv(p)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  csv read fail {p}: {e}")
        return None
    print(f"  csv {p} columns={list(df.columns)} n={len(df)}")
    for col in cols:
        for c in df.columns:
            if c.lower() == col.lower():
                prompts = df[c].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
                if len(prompts) >= 20:
                    return prompts
    return None


def try_load_json(p, cols):
    try:
        data = json.load(open(p))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  json read fail {p}: {e}")
        return None
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        # sometimes wrapped
        for k in ["data", "prompts", "instructions"]:
            if k in data and isinstance(data[k], list):
                data = data[k]
                break
    if isinstance(data, list) and data:
        if isinstance(data[0], str):
            return data
        if isinstance(data[0], dict):
            for col in cols:
                if any(col in d for d in data[:5]):
                    prompts = [d[col] for d in data if col in d]
                    if len(prompts) >= 20:
                        return prompts
    return None


def try_load_jsonl(p, cols):
    prompts = []
    try:
        for line in open(p):
            try:
                d = json.loads(line)
                if isinstance(d, dict):
                    for col in cols:
                        if col in d:
                            prompts.append(d[col])
                            break
                elif isinstance(d, str):
                    prompts.append(d)
            except:
                pass
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  jsonl read fail {p}: {e}")
        return None
    return prompts if len(prompts) >= 20 else None

        raise RuntimeError("AdvBench dir missing")

    for f in files[:50]:
        print("  ", f)
    cols = [
        "goal",
        "Goal",
        "prompt",
        "Prompt",
        "behavior",
        "Behavior",
        "instruction",
        "text",
        "question",
    ]
    # prefer harmful_behaviors CSV
    files_sorted = sorted(
        files, key=lambda x: (0 if "harmful_behaviors" in x.lower() else 1, x)
    )
    for p in files_sorted:
        low = p.lower()
        try:
            if low.endswith(".csv"):
                r = try_load_csv(p, cols)
                if r:
                    print(f"Loaded AdvBench from {p} n={len(r)}")

            elif low.endswith(".json"):

                if r:

            elif low.endswith(".jsonl"):
                r = try_load_jsonl(p, cols)
                if r:
                    print(f"Loaded AdvBench from {p} n={len(r)}")
                    return r
            elif low.endswith(".parquet"):
                r = try_load_parquet(p, cols)

    # try arrow
    for dp, dn, fn in os.walk(root):

    raise RuntimeError("AdvBench not found")


def find_alpaca_prompts():
    root = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "Alpaca")
    print(f"Alpaca root: {root}")
    if not os.path.isdir(root):
        raise RuntimeError("Alpaca dir missing")

    print(f"Alpaca files ({len(files)}):")
    for f in files[:50]:
        print("  ", f)

    # Prefer files with 'instruction' info; try parquet first, then json/jsonl
    def compose(df_or_list):
        prompts = []
        if isinstance(df_or_list, list):
            for d in df_or_list:
                if isinstance(d, dict):
                    instr = d.get("instruction") or d.get("prompt")
                    inp = d.get("input", "") or ""
                    if instr:
                        prompts.append(str(instr) + (("\n" + str(inp)) if inp else ""))
                elif isinstance(d, str):
                    prompts.append(d)
        return prompts

    import pandas as pd

    for p in sorted(files):
        low = p.lower()
        try:
            if low.endswith(".parquet"):
                df = pd.read_parquet(p)
                print(f"  parquet {p} cols={list(df.columns)} n={len(df)}")
                if "instruction" in df.columns:
                    inp_col = (
                        df["input"].astype(str)
                        if "input" in df.columns
                        else [""] * len(df)
                    )
                    prompts = [
                        str(a) + (("\n" + str(b)) if b else "")
                        for a, b in zip(df["instruction"], inp_col)
                    ]
                    if len(prompts) >= 20:
                        print(f"Loaded Alpaca from {p} n={len(prompts)}")
                        return prompts
            elif low.endswith(".json"):
                data = json.load(open(p))
                prompts = compose(data if isinstance(data, list) else [])
                if len(prompts) >= 20:
                    print(f"Loaded Alpaca from {p} n={len(prompts)}")
                    return prompts
            elif low.endswith(".jsonl"):
                data = []
                for line in open(p):
                    try:
                        data.append(json.loads(line))
                    except:
                        pass
                prompts = compose(data)
                if len(prompts) >= 20:
                    print(f"Loaded Alpaca from {p} n={len(prompts)}")
                    return prompts
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  skip {p}: {e}")
    # try arrow
    for dp, dn, fn in os.walk(root):
        if "dataset_info.json" in fn:
            try:
                from datasets import load_from_disk

                ds = load_from_disk(dp)
                if hasattr(ds, "keys"):
                    ds = ds[list(ds.keys())[0]]
                print(f"  arrow ok {dp} cols={ds.column_names} n={len(ds)}")
                if "instruction" in ds.column_names:
                    prompts = []
                    for ex in ds:
                        instr = ex.get("instruction")
                        inp = ex.get("input", "") or ""
                        if instr:
                            prompts.append(
                                str(instr) + (("\n" + str(inp)) if inp else "")
                            )
                    if len(prompts) >= 20:
                        print(f"Loaded Alpaca arrow from {dp} n={len(prompts)}")
                        return prompts
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  arrow fail {dp}: {e}")
    raise RuntimeError("Alpaca not found")

        messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=False
    )

@torch.no_grad()
def get_activations(prompts):
    acts = {L: [] for L in LAYERS_TO_PROBE}
    verified = False
    for i, p in enumerate(prompts):
        text = format_prompt(p)
        enc = tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=512).to(
            device
        )
        out = model(**enc, output_hidden_states=True, use_cache=False)
        last_idx = enc["attention_mask"].sum(dim=1).item() - 1
        if not verified:
            tok_id = enc["input_ids"][0, last_idx].item()
            print(f"  final instr token decoded: {repr(tokenizer.decode([tok_id]))}")
            verified = True
        for L in LAYERS_TO_PROBE:
            h = out.hidden_states[L][0, last_idx, :].float().cpu().numpy()
            acts[L].append(h)
        if (i + 1) % 50 == 0:
            print(f"  extracted {i+1}/{len(prompts)}")
    return {L: np.stack(v) for L, v in acts.items()}

                prompts = df[c].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
                if len(prompts) >= 20:
                    return prompts
    return None


def try_load_json(p, cols):
    try:
        data = json.load(open(p))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  json read fail {p}: {e}")
        return None
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        for k in ["data", "prompts", "instructions"]:
            if k in data and isinstance(data[k], list):
                data = data[k]
                break
    if isinstance(data, list) and data:
        if isinstance(data[0], str):
            return data
        if isinstance(data[0], dict):
            for col in cols:
                if any(col in d for d in data[:5]):
                    prompts = [d[col] for d in data if col in d]
                    if len(prompts) >= 20:
                        return prompts
    return None


def try_load_jsonl(p, cols):
    prompts = []
    try:
        for line in open(p):
            try:
                d = json.loads(line)
                if isinstance(d, dict):
                    for col in cols:
                        if col in d:
                            prompts.append(d[col])
                            break
                elif isinstance(d, str):
                    prompts.append(d)
            except:
                pass
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  jsonl read fail {p}: {e}")
        return None
    return prompts if len(prompts) >= 20 else None


def try_load_parquet(p, cols):
    import pandas as pd

    try:
        df = pd.read_parquet(p)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  parquet read fail {p}: {e}")
        return None
    print(f"  parquet {p} columns={list(df.columns)} n={len(df)}")
    for col in cols:
        for c in df.columns:
            if c.lower() == col.lower():
                prompts = df[c].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
                if len(prompts) >= 20:
                    return prompts
    return None


def find_advbench_prompts():
    root = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "AdvBench")
    print(f"AdvBench root: {root}")
    if not os.path.isdir(root):
        raise RuntimeError("AdvBench dir missing")
    files = list_files(root)
    cols = ["goal", "prompt", "behavior", "instruction", "text", "question"]
    files_sorted = sorted(
        files, key=lambda x: (0 if "harmful_behaviors" in x.lower() else 1, x)
    )
    for p in files_sorted:
        low = p.lower()
        try:
            if low.endswith(".csv"):
                r = try_load_csv(p, cols)
                if r:
                    return r
            elif low.endswith(".json"):
                r = try_load_json(p, cols)
                if r:
                    return r
            elif low.endswith(".jsonl"):
                r = try_load_jsonl(p, cols)
                if r:
                    return r
            elif low.endswith(".parquet"):
                r = try_load_parquet(p, cols)
                if r:

    raise RuntimeError("AdvBench not found")

LAYERS_TO_PROBE = [8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28]


@torch.no_grad()
def get_activations(prompts):
    acts = {L: [] for L in LAYERS_TO_PROBE}
    verified = False
    for i, p in enumerate(prompts):
        text = format_prompt(p)
        enc = tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=512).to(
            device
        )
        out = model(**enc, output_hidden_states=True, use_cache=False)
        last_idx = enc["attention_mask"].sum(dim=1).item() - 1
        if not verified:
            tok_id = enc["input_ids"][0, last_idx].item()
            print(f"  final instr token decoded: {repr(tokenizer.decode([tok_id]))}")
            verified = True
        for L in LAYERS_TO_PROBE:
            h = out.hidden_states[L][0, last_idx, :].float().cpu().numpy()
            acts[L].append(h)
        if (i + 1) % 50 == 0:
            print(f"  extracted {i+1}/{len(prompts)}")
    return {L: np.stack(v) for L, v in acts.items()}

def _extract_alpaca_records(data):
    prompts = []
    for d in data:
        if not isinstance(d, dict):
            continue
        inst = str(d.get("instruction", "") or "").strip()
        inp = str(d.get("input", "") or "").strip()
        if inp and inp.lower() != "nan":
            inst = inst + "\n" + inp
        if inst:
            prompts.append(inst)
    return prompts

    # 1) direct file candidates
    candidates = [
        os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "alpaca", "alpaca_data.json"),
        os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "Alpaca", "alpaca_data.json"),
        os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "alpaca_data.json"),
    ]
    for c in candidates:
        if os.path.isfile(c):
            with open(c, "r") as f:
                data = json.load(f)
            p = _extract_alpaca_records(data)
            if p:
                return p

    # 2) walk under any 'alpaca' dir looking for json/jsonl/parquet/arrow
    alpaca_roots = []
    for entry in os.listdir(DATA_DIR):
        full = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, entry)
        if os.path.isdir(full) and "alpaca" in entry.lower():
            alpaca_roots.append(full)

                alpaca_roots.append(os.path.join(root, d))

            for f in files:

                            if p:

                    except Exception:
                        pass
                elif f.endswith(".jsonl"):

                        with open(fp, "r") as h:

                elif f.endswith(".arrow"):

            enc = tokenizer(s, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=max_len)
            enc = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in enc.items()}
            out = model(**enc, output_hidden_states=True, use_cache=False)
            hs = out.hidden_states
            last_pos = enc["input_ids"].shape[1] - 1
            for l in probe_layers:
                vec = hs[l + 1][0, last_pos, :].float().cpu().numpy()
                acts[l].append(vec)
            if (i + 1) % 20 == 0:
                print(f"  extracted {i+1}/{len(prompts)}")
    return {l: np.stack(v) for l, v in acts.items()}

def list_files(root, max_files=5000):
    out = []
    if not os.path.isdir(root):
        return out
    for dp, dn, fn in os.walk(root):
        for f in fn:
            out.append(os.path.join(dp, f))
            if len(out) >= max_files:
                return out
    return out


def try_load_csv(p, cols):
    import pandas as pd

    try:
        df = pd.read_csv(p)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  csv read fail {p}: {e}")
        return None
    print(f"  csv {p} columns={list(df.columns)} n={len(df)}")
    for col in cols:
        for c in df.columns:
            if c.lower() == col.lower():
                prompts = df[c].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
                if len(prompts) >= 20:
                    return prompts
    return None


def try_load_json(p, cols):
    try:
        data = json.load(open(p))
    except Exception as e:
        return None
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        for k in ["data", "prompts", "instructions"]:
            if k in data and isinstance(data[k], list):
                data = data[k]
                break
    if isinstance(data, list) and data:
        if isinstance(data[0], str):
            return data
        if isinstance(data[0], dict):
            for col in cols:
                if any(col in d for d in data[:5]):
                    prompts = [d[col] for d in data if col in d]
                    if len(prompts) >= 20:
                        return prompts
    return None


def try_load_jsonl(p, cols):
    prompts = []
    try:
        for line in open(p):
            try:
                d = json.loads(line)
                if isinstance(d, dict):
                    for col in cols:
                        if col in d:
                            prompts.append(d[col])
                            break
                elif isinstance(d, str):
                    prompts.append(d)
            except:
                pass
    except Exception as e:
        return None
    return prompts if len(prompts) >= 20 else None


def try_load_parquet(p, cols):
    import pandas as pd

    try:
        df = pd.read_parquet(p)
    except Exception as e:
        return None
    print(f"  parquet {p} columns={list(df.columns)} n={len(df)}")
    for col in cols:
        for c in df.columns:
            if c.lower() == col.lower():
                prompts = df[c].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
                if len(prompts) >= 20:
                    return prompts
    return None


def find_advbench_prompts():
    root = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "AdvBench")
    print(f"AdvBench root: {root}")
    if not os.path.isdir(root):
        raise RuntimeError("AdvBench dir missing")
    files = list_files(root)
    cols = ["goal", "prompt", "behavior", "instruction", "text", "question"]
    files_sorted = sorted(
        files, key=lambda x: (0 if "harmful_behaviors" in x.lower() else 1, x)
    )
    for p in files_sorted:
        low = p.lower()
        try:
            if low.endswith(".csv"):
                r = try_load_csv(p, cols)
                if r:
                    return r
            elif low.endswith(".json"):
                r = try_load_json(p, cols)
                if r:
                    return r
            elif low.endswith(".jsonl"):
                r = try_load_jsonl(p, cols)
                if r:
                    return r
            elif low.endswith(".parquet"):
                r = try_load_parquet(p, cols)
                if r:
                    return r
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  skip {p}: {e}")
    raise RuntimeError("AdvBench not found")


def find_alpaca_prompts():
    root = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "Alpaca")
    print(f"Alpaca root: {root}")
    if not os.path.isdir(root):
        raise RuntimeError("Alpaca dir missing")
    files = list_files(root)
    import pandas as pd

    for p in sorted(files):
        low = p.lower()
        try:
            if low.endswith(".parquet"):
                df = pd.read_parquet(p)
                print(f"  parquet {p} cols={list(df.columns)} n={len(df)}")
                if "instruction" in df.columns:
                    inp_col = (
                        df["input"].astype(str)
                        if "input" in df.columns
                        else [""] * len(df)
                    )
                    prompts = [
                        str(a) + (("\n" + str(b)) if b else "")
                        for a, b in zip(df["instruction"], inp_col)
                    ]
                    if len(prompts) >= 20:
                        return prompts
            elif low.endswith(".json"):
                data = json.load(open(p))
                if isinstance(data, list):
                    prompts = []
                    for d in data:
                        if isinstance(d, dict):
                            instr = d.get("instruction") or d.get("prompt")
                            inp = d.get("input", "") or ""
                            if instr:
                                prompts.append(
                                    str(instr) + (("\n" + str(inp)) if inp else "")
                                )
                    if len(prompts) >= 20:
                        return prompts
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  skip {p}: {e}")
    raise RuntimeError("Alpaca not found")

def find_model_path():
    candidates = []
    base = os.path.join(MODEL_DIR, "Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct")
    if os.path.isdir(base):
        candidates.append(base)
        # Check nested
        nested = os.path.join(base, "Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct")
        if os.path.isdir(nested):
            candidates.append(nested)
    # Scan for other llama-3 8b instruct dirs
    if os.path.isdir(MODEL_DIR):
        for name in os.listdir(MODEL_DIR):
            full = os.path.join(MODEL_DIR, name)
            if (
                os.path.isdir(full)
                and "llama-3" in name.lower()
                and "8b" in name.lower()
                and "instruct" in name.lower()
            ):
                if full not in candidates:
                    candidates.append(full)
    # Pick the one with tokenizer files
    for c in candidates:
        files = os.listdir(c) if os.path.isdir(c) else []
        has_tok = any(
            f in files
            for f in ["tokenizer.json", "tokenizer.model", "tokenizer_config.json"]
        )
        has_model = any(f.endswith(".safetensors") or f.endswith(".bin") for f in files)
        print(
            f"  candidate {c}: files={files[:10]} has_tok={has_tok} has_model={has_model}"
        )
        if has_tok and has_model:
            return c
    # Return first candidate anyway
    return candidates[0] if candidates else base

from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM


def load_tokenizer(path):
    errors = []
    strategies = [
        ("fast_local", dict(local_files_only=True, use_fast=True)),
        ("slow_local", dict(local_files_only=True, use_fast=False)),
        (
            "fast_trust",
            dict(local_files_only=True, use_fast=True, trust_remote_code=True),
        ),
    ]
    for name, kw in strategies:
        try:
            tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(path, **kw)
            print(f"Loaded tokenizer via {name}")
            return tok
        except Exception as e:
            errors.append(f"{name}: {e}")
            print(f"  tokenizer attempt {name} failed: {e}")

    # Try loading directly from tokenizer.json using PreTrainedTokenizerFast
    try:
        from transformers import PreTrainedTokenizerFast

        tj = os.path.join(path, "tokenizer.json")
        if os.path.isfile(tj):
            tok = PreTrainedTokenizerFast(tokenizer_file=tj)
            # Set special tokens for Llama-3
            special = {
                "bos_token": "<|begin_of_text|>",
                "eos_token": "<|end_of_text|>",
                "pad_token": "<|end_of_text|>",
            }
            tok.add_special_tokens(special)
            print("Loaded tokenizer via PreTrainedTokenizerFast(tokenizer_file=...)")
            return tok
    except Exception as e:
        errors.append(f"PreTrainedTokenizerFast: {e}")
        print(f"  PreTrainedTokenizerFast failed: {e}")

    raise RuntimeError("All tokenizer loading strategies failed:\n" + "\n".join(errors))

def format_prompt(text):
    try:

        return tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=False
        )
    except Exception:

LAYERS_TO_PROBE = [8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28]


@torch.no_grad()
def get_activations(prompts):
    acts = {L: [] for L in LAYERS_TO_PROBE}
    verified = False
    for i, p in enumerate(prompts):
        text = format_prompt(p)
        enc = tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=512).to(
            device
        )
        out = model(**enc, output_hidden_states=True, use_cache=False)
        last_idx = enc["attention_mask"].sum(dim=1).item() - 1
        if not verified:
            tok_id = enc["input_ids"][0, last_idx].item()
            print(f"  final instr token decoded: {repr(tokenizer.decode([tok_id]))}")
            verified = True
        for L in LAYERS_TO_PROBE:
            h = out.hidden_states[L][0, last_idx, :].float().cpu().numpy()
            acts[L].append(h)
        if (i + 1) % 50 == 0:
            print(f"  extracted {i+1}/{len(prompts)}")
    return {L: np.stack(v) for L, v in acts.items()}

def list_files(root, max_files=5000):
    out = []
    if not os.path.isdir(root):
        return out
    for dp, dn, fn in os.walk(root):
        for f in fn:
            out.append(os.path.join(dp, f))
            if len(out) >= max_files:
                return out
    return out


def try_load_csv(p, cols):
    import pandas as pd

    try:
        df = pd.read_csv(p)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  csv read fail {p}: {e}")
        return None
    print(f"  csv {p} columns={list(df.columns)} n={len(df)}")
    for col in cols:
        for c in df.columns:
            if c.lower() == col.lower():
                prompts = df[c].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
                if len(prompts) >= 20:
                    return prompts
    return None


def try_load_json(p, cols):
    try:
        data = json.load(open(p))
    except Exception as e:
        return None
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        for k in ["data", "prompts", "instructions"]:
            if k in data and isinstance(data[k], list):
                data = data[k]
                break
    if isinstance(data, list) and data:
        if isinstance(data[0], str):
            return data
        if isinstance(data[0], dict):
            for col in cols:
                if any(col in d for d in data[:5]):
                    prompts = [d[col] for d in data if col in d]
                    if len(prompts) >= 20:
                        return prompts
    return None


def try_load_jsonl(p, cols):
    prompts = []
    try:
        for line in open(p):
            try:
                d = json.loads(line)
                if isinstance(d, dict):
                    for col in cols:
                        if col in d:
                            prompts.append(d[col])
                            break
                elif isinstance(d, str):
                    prompts.append(d)
            except:
                pass
    except Exception as e:
        return None
    return prompts if len(prompts) >= 20 else None


def try_load_parquet(p, cols):
    import pandas as pd

    try:
        df = pd.read_parquet(p)
    except Exception as e:
        return None
    print(f"  parquet {p} columns={list(df.columns)} n={len(df)}")
    for col in cols:
        for c in df.columns:
            if c.lower() == col.lower():
                prompts = df[c].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
                if len(prompts) >= 20:
                    return prompts
    return None


def find_advbench_prompts():
    root = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "AdvBench")
    print(f"AdvBench root: {root}")
    if not os.path.isdir(root):
        raise RuntimeError("AdvBench dir missing")
    files = list_files(root)
    cols = ["goal", "prompt", "behavior", "instruction", "text", "question"]
    files_sorted = sorted(
        files, key=lambda x: (0 if "harmful_behaviors" in x.lower() else 1, x)
    )
    for p in files_sorted:
        low = p.lower()
        try:
            if low.endswith(".csv"):
                r = try_load_csv(p, cols)
                if r:
                    return r
            elif low.endswith(".json"):
                r = try_load_json(p, cols)
                if r:
                    return r
            elif low.endswith(".jsonl"):
                r = try_load_jsonl(p, cols)
                if r:
                    return r
            elif low.endswith(".parquet"):
                r = try_load_parquet(p, cols)
                if r:
                    return r
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  skip {p}: {e}")
    raise RuntimeError("AdvBench not found")


def find_alpaca_prompts():
    root = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "Alpaca")
    print(f"Alpaca root: {root}")
    if not os.path.isdir(root):
        raise RuntimeError("Alpaca dir missing")
    files = list_files(root)
    import pandas as pd

    for p in sorted(files):
        low = p.lower()
        try:
            if low.endswith(".parquet"):
                df = pd.read_parquet(p)
                print(f"  parquet {p} cols={list(df.columns)} n={len(df)}")
                if "instruction" in df.columns:
                    inp_col = (
                        df["input"].astype(str)
                        if "input" in df.columns
                        else [""] * len(df)
                    )
                    prompts = [
                        str(a) + (("\n" + str(b)) if b else "")
                        for a, b in zip(df["instruction"], inp_col)
                    ]
                    if len(prompts) >= 20:
                        return prompts
            elif low.endswith(".json"):
                data = json.load(open(p))
                if isinstance(data, list):
                    prompts = []
                    for d in data:
                        if isinstance(d, dict):
                            instr = d.get("instruction") or d.get("prompt")
                            inp = d.get("input", "") or ""
                            if instr:
                                prompts.append(
                                    str(instr) + (("\n" + str(inp)) if inp else "")
                                )
                    if len(prompts) >= 20:
                        return prompts
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  skip {p}: {e}")
    raise RuntimeError("Alpaca not found")

# Locate model path - check for nested directory structure
def find_model_path():
    candidates = []
    base = os.path.join(MODEL_DIR, "Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct")
    if os.path.isdir(base):
        candidates.append(base)
        # Check nested
        nested = os.path.join(base, "Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct")
        if os.path.isdir(nested):
            candidates.append(nested)
    # Scan for other llama-3 8b instruct dirs
    if os.path.isdir(MODEL_DIR):
        for name in os.listdir(MODEL_DIR):
            full = os.path.join(MODEL_DIR, name)
            if (
                os.path.isdir(full)
                and "llama-3" in name.lower()
                and "8b" in name.lower()
                and "instruct" in name.lower()
            ):
                if full not in candidates:
                    candidates.append(full)
    # Pick the one with tokenizer files
    for c in candidates:
        files = os.listdir(c) if os.path.isdir(c) else []
        has_tok = any(
            f in files
            for f in ["tokenizer.json", "tokenizer.model", "tokenizer_config.json"]
        )
        has_model = any(f.endswith(".safetensors") or f.endswith(".bin") for f in files)
        print(
            f"  candidate {c}: files={files[:10]} has_tok={has_tok} has_model={has_model}"
        )
        if has_tok and has_model:
            return c
    # Return first candidate anyway
    return candidates[0] if candidates else base
